principle: One registry for every Dictionary volume. A book owns a namespace (ns) used for cross-links written as "<ns>:<slug>", where slug is the part of an entry id after idPrefix. conceptRef (atlas:concept/<slug>, including seed-NNNN) points into the Atlas concept layer, not into a book. visibility "private" = never committed (the data file is gitignored) and never shown on the public site; the viewer lists it only on localhost.
